verifiedImprovements: Gold lower collar now reads as a straight cylindrical band with bounded upper/lower edges; previous bulging ring reflections are removed.
Gold central wall produces straighter vertical light bands, and the shoulder-to-body transition follows the new rounded profile.
The open white actuator has discernible crown/side transitions; the close inspection image shows the shallow recessed short-spout opening.
Complete pump and transparent tube remain connected through closed, half and fully open states.
All five approved groups remain in the normal desktop and simulated-mobile compositions; no new viewport clipping or displaced part was observed.
Original flat glass bottle, blank paper backing and complete watercolor lettering layer remain visually consistent.

comparativeAssessment.goldCollar: Clearly improved in same-scale before/after closed and open screenshots.
comparativeAssessment.goldMainWall: Straighter and less inflated; studio reflections intentionally remain soft.
comparativeAssessment.whiteActuatorOpen: Small but visible improvement in the normal open view, clearer in the temporary detail view.
comparativeAssessment.whiteActuatorClosed: Still very bright through the transparent cap; tonal separation is weaker than the open view.
comparativeAssessment.outlet: Actual recess visible in close inspection; too small to judge at the normal fully expanded overview scale.

limits: The closed white head remains very bright behind the clear overcap; do not claim all white-head clipping is eliminated.
At the normal fully expanded overview the pump occupies only a small screen area; magnified screenshot crops are comparison aids, not proof of native detail at that scale.
The temporary 1.7x pump-detail-screen image intentionally clips the bottle and overcap and is excluded from the standard-framing pass.
Gold shoulder reflections are softer and glossier than the photographic reference; they are still clearly metallic rather than a sharp-edged technical drawing.
Clear dip tube has low contrast against the pink backdrop; mobile package microcopy remains small.
At 90 degrees the planar printed layer becomes edge-on.
No physical device, native-touch, manufacturing, deployment or live-site validation is part of this visual review.
